title: Figure 9: Positron SSRV flight profile, altitude vs. time by propulsion mode
description: Line chart of altitude (km, log scale 0.1-1000) versus time (0-1500+ sec) for a positron single-stage reusable vehicle, with shaded phases labeled "TURBOJET MODE" (red), "RAMJET MODE" (yellow) and "ROCKET MODE" (blue). Annotations mark t = 146 sec (M = 1.8, 10000 m), t = 1200 sec (M = 8, 38 km), t = 1530 sec (v = 7600 m/sec, 140 km) and t = 1650 sec (300 km); a small aircraft icon sits on the curve. Caption: "Figure 9. Positron SSRV Flight Profile (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)." Table 3 of positron mass requirements appears below.
